🗑 Delete SOs — Permanently remove Sales Orders created by mistake
⚠️ This permanently deletes the SO from the OAB sheet — including any dispatch, invoice link, and stage history on that row. This cannot be undone. Only use this for SOs created by mistake (e.g. duplicate entry, wrong customer/spec). Genuine short-closes should use "Close SO" on the Daily Update page instead.

👤 Users & Access — App Logins

Create logins for your team, assign each an access level, change passwords, or remove users. To change a password, edit the field and click Save. The primary operations login (superstar) can't be deleted, and you can't delete the account you're currently signed in with.

🧹 Production Reset — Sales & Sadmin data

Permanently clears all Sales-Rep and Sales-Admin data from the shared cloud so you can go live with a blank slate: leads, contacts, visits/interactions, SKUs, CSA reports, quotations, POs, targets, negotiations and the sales-rep login accounts — plus drop-down customizations. This does not touch OAB, invoices, purchase, or your admin logins. This cannot be undone.

🧩 Drop-down selections

Central control for every editable drop-down used across the app's logins. Pick a drop-down on the left, then add, edit, or remove its options on the right. Changes are shared with all logins.

🏢 Customers & Dispatch Locations

Uploading fully overwrites the customer master and updates dispatch/location data used in OAB and invoicing. Columns are read by header name: Group, Customer Name, Billing/Shipping Address, Dispatch Location, Location Code, Contact Person/Phone/Email, GSTN, State, Secondary Contact/Phone/Email, Remarks, Active/Inactive. Or add/edit rows manually below.
